import os, glob, statistics, re
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime, parseaddr, getaddresses

MINE = "michael.scott@dundermifflin.com"
base = os.path.expanduser("~/Maildir")
folders = [d for d in ["", ".Work", ".Travel", ".Receipts"] ]  # inbound-bearing folders

msgs = {}   # message-id -> dict
records = []

def norm(mid):
    if mid is None: return None
    mid = mid.strip()
    m = re.search(r'<([^>]*)>', mid)
    return ("<"+m.group(1)+">") if m else ("<"+mid+">")

files = []
for f in folders:
    for sub in ("cur","new"):
        files += glob.glob(os.path.join(base, f, sub, "*"))
# also scan Sent to catch replies stored there
for sub in ("cur","new"):
    files += glob.glob(os.path.join(base, ".Sent", sub, "*"))

for path in files:
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as fh:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(fh)
    except Exception:
        continue
    mid = norm(msg.get("Message-ID"))
    frm_hdr = msg.get("From","")
    frm_name, frm_addr = parseaddr(frm_hdr)
    date = None
    try:
        date = parsedate_to_datetime(msg.get("Date"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    ir = norm(msg.get("In-Reply-To"))
    refs = [norm(x) for x in re.findall(r'<[^>]*>', msg.get("References","") or "")]
    subj = str(msg.get("Subject","")).strip()
    records.append(dict(path=path, mid=mid, frm_addr=frm_addr.lower(), frm_name=frm_name,
                        date=date, ir=ir, refs=refs, subj=subj))
    if mid and mid not in msgs:
        msgs[mid] = records[-1]

print("parsed:", len(records), "indexed:", len(msgs))

# Build reply events: each message FROM me that references a message FROM someone else
reply_deltas = {}     # sender_addr -> list of hours
sender_names = {}     # addr -> display name seen
seen_inbound = {}     # addr -> set of their message ids (candidate things to reply to)

for r in records:
    if r["frm_addr"]==MINE: continue
    if r["frm_addr"]:
        seen_inbound.setdefault(r["frm_addr"], set()).add(r["mid"])
        if r["frm_name"]: sender_names[r["frm_addr"]] = r["frm_name"]

for r in records:
    if r["frm_addr"]!=MINE: continue
    if not r["date"]: continue
    parent_id = r["ir"] or (r["refs"][-1] if r["refs"] else None)
    # pick most recent referenced non-mine message as the thing replied to
    cands = [c for c in ([r["ir"]]+r["refs"]) if c and c in msgs and msgs[c]["frm_addr"] not in ("", MINE)]
    if not cands: continue
    parent = max((msgs[c] for c in cands), key=lambda m:(m["date"] or min))
    if not parent["date"]: continue
    who = parent["frm_addr"]
    dt = (r["date"] - parent["date"]).total_seconds()/3600.0
    if dt < 0:   # clock skew / out-of-order; skip negative
        continue
    reply_deltas.setdefault(who, []).append(dt)

# Unanswered: inbound msgs whose thread root never got a reply from me
replied_thread_roots = set()
for r in records:
    if r["frm_addr"]!=MINE: continue
    roots = [c for c in ([r["ir"]]+r["refs"]) if c]
    if roots: replied_thread_roots.update(roots)

def domain(a): return a.split("@")[-1] if "@" in a else a

rows=[]
for who, ds in reply_deltas.items():
    n=len(ds)
    med=statistics.median(ds); mean=statistics.mean(ds)
    fast=sum(1 for d in ds if d<=24)/n*100
    slow=sum(1 for d in ds if d>=72)/n*100
    tot_in=len(seen_inbound.get(who,set()))
    rows.append((who, sender_names.get(who,""), n, round(med,1), round(mean,1), round(fast), round(slow), tot_in))

rows.sort(key=lambda x:x[3])  # fastest median first
print("\n%-34s %-22s %3s %8s %8s %6s %6s %5s"%("SENDER","NAME","N","MED_h","MEAN_h","%<24h","%>72h","#IN"))
for w,nm,n,med,mean,fast,slow,tot in rows[:40]:
    print("%-34s %-22s %3d %8.1f %8.1f %5d%% %5d%% %5d"%(w[:34],nm[:22],n,med,mean,fast,slow,tot))
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/triage.py
